name: Acsion Limited
summary: Acsion Limited engages in property holding and development activities in South Africa. The company operates through International Property Operations, South African Property Operations, and South African Hospitality Operations segments. Its investment portfolio includes retail properties, light industrial property, and a mixed-used property, as well as an international retail property. In addition, the company develops regional shopping centers, community shopping centers, convenience shopping centers, and neighborhood shopping centers, as well as industrial, residential, and hospitality properties; operates hotels; and provides property and asset management services.
